//: brainify writes this to a new hub's .claude/settings.json. Two jobs: (1) make Product Brain available in every Claude surface that opens this hub — CLI, VS Code/JetBrains, desktop, and cloud/Cowork sessions — by declaring the marketplace + plugin, and (2) pre-allow the safe commands the team runs so teammates aren't prompted for each one. Path-free and safe to commit (no machine paths). Personal approvals and tokens go in the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json (see settings-local.example.template.json). env.PYTHONUTF8 makes pb and graphify read/write UTF-8 on Windows, whose default code page cannot encode the emoji in pb's reports.
